comments.author: hsliuustc0106
comments.body:
Please complete the target-hardware validation before this recipe is merged. The section is still entirely `<TODO>`, and it says the recorded run was a five-step profiling validation while the 50-step request immediately below is followed by 4-minute and 10-minute latency claims.

Please identify the exact workload those timings came from and report the validated host topology, CUDA/driver/PyTorch versions, device order, warmup method, and per-GPU peak HBM. Fill the measured 2/4/8-GPU entries, or clearly label configurations that were derived but not tested. If the timings came from the five-step run, do not attribute them to the 50-step example; if they came from the shown 50-step request, update the validation text accordingly.
